g.text: The name is a plain search field, and it
is matched against the name of the file
the rows whose names hold it are kept,
and the folders on the way to them
The kind chips: All, MD, HTML, PDF, IMG,
SHEET, OTHER. The kind is decided by the
the files of that kind are kept
The list holds only the extensions the
tree really has: it is filled from the
the files with that extension are kept
the files that size are kept
the files touched then are kept
F-7: the filters are controls, not a
language. Folders are never filtered out:
they are the way to the files.
the tree says so, in words
